Description:
Short video for sculpting mirror !  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M0GwLF6MZes&ab_channel=DevilPeaceArts

Hello, I made discord only to help you improve your skills with sculpting head. 

Discord Link :  https://discord.gg/BuBCczRsHT

It's a beginner tutorial at first we start with simpler shapes and form. That way we make a good base from which we can more more in-depth and this way we can slowly increase the details and complexity of over project while not making it to complicated on workflow.

Video title: How to Make NPCs/AI Run Away (with examples in Unity)

Channel: Feed My Kids

URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RGjMBEGhd7Y&list=PLMU4d-OqRsgRnR83Z9gnyqDLa6w_Dy9gg

Description:
In this video you'll learn how to make one object "run away" from another. Hopefully, you'll learn a little vector math with simple examples.

To sum up the entire video: 
1. Get the direction to the object you're running from. (Dir = Obj2 Pos - Obj1 Pos)
2. Negate the direction (Dir = -Dir)
3. Run in that direction (Obj1.RunToPos (Obj1 Pos +. Dir))
4. Scale the direction if you want by normalizing the direction vector. (Dir = Dir.normalized)
5. Run a certain distance away using the normalized direction. 
[Obj1.RunToPos(MyPos + (Dir * desiredDistance))]

You'll need a copy of Unity for this: Try getting a version higher than Unity 5.6

The code, materials, and prefabs from this video can be found here:
